title: Human-AI Mutualism Is Unstable under Capability Asymmetry
abstract: arXiv:2611.23322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One hope for a good human future alongside advanced AI rests on enduring mutualism: humans and AI will need each other, so the relationship will stay good for both. We argue that this hope fails as AI capability grows. Bargaining guarantees each side only what it would get if bargaining failed. For humans, this can be less than they had before AI. In a simple game-theoretic model, humans stay as well off as before AI without alignment only while they have leverage over the AI: either the AI depends on what they supply, or they can impose costs on the AI that are large relative to what the AI can produce. Once humans have neither kind of leverage, they stay as well off as before AI only if the AI is aligned with them. If the AI's goals are insatiable, the alignment required approaches perfect alignment as AI capability grows. Thus, mutualism is not a substitute for alignment. translated_title: 能力不对称条件下人类-AI共生关系的不稳定性
translated_abstract: 人类与先进AI共同拥有美好未来的一个希望寄托于持久的共生关系：人类和AI将彼此需要，因此这种关系将对双方持续保持良好。我们认为，随着AI能力的增长，这一希望将会落空。谈判只能保证每一方获得其在谈判破裂时所得到的收益，而对人类来说，这可能低于他们在AI出现之前所拥有的水平。在一个简单的博弈论模型中，只有当人类对AI拥有筹码时，人类才能在没有对齐的情况下保持与AI出现前同样好的境况：即要么AI依赖于人类所提供的东西，要么人类能够对AI施加相对于AI所能创造的价值而言足够大的成本。一旦人类不再拥有任何一种筹码，只有当AI与他们保持对齐时，他们才能维持AI出现前的境况。如果AI的目标是贪得无厌的，那么随着AI能力的增长，所需的对齐程度将趋近于完美对齐。因此，共生关系不能替代对齐。而当保留更多资源的AI变体传播得更快时……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型证明，随着AI能力增长，人类对AI的筹码终将消失，人机共生关系由此变得不稳定，因此共生不能替代对齐——只有AI与人类对齐才能保障人类福祉。
en_tdlr: Using a game-theoretic model, this paper shows that human-AI mutualism becomes unstable as AI capability grows, since human leverage vanishes, and thus mutualism is no substitute for alignment.
